trans-unit.source: This app needs local network access when its integration features are configured accordingly.
trans-unit.target: Aplikacija potrebuje dostop do lokalnega omrežja, ko so njene funkcije integracije ustrezno konfigurirane.

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, the app will not send crash reports to the developer. Crash reporting is handled by Sentry (sentry.io).
trans-unit.source: If you deny these connections, the app will not send crash reports to the developer. Crash reporting is handled by Sentry (sentry.io).
trans-unit.target: Če zavrnete te povezave, aplikacija razvijalcu ne bo pošiljala poročil o zrušitvah. Poročanje o zrušitvah obravnava Sentry (sentry.io).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be able to purchase or activate a Pro license. Licensing is managed by Paddle (paddle.com).
trans-unit.source: If you deny these connections, you will not be able to purchase or activate a Pro license. Licensing is managed by Paddle (paddle.com).
trans-unit.target: Če zavrnete te povezave, ne boste mogli kupiti ali aktivirati licence Pro. Licenciranje upravlja Paddle (paddle.com).

trans-unit.id: If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions and will not be able to update to newer app versions using the app's UI.
trans-unit.source: If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions and will not be able to update to newer app versions using the app's UI.
trans-unit.target: Če te povezave zavrnete, ne boste obveščeni o novih različicah in ne boste mogli posodobiti na novejše različice aplikacije z uporabniškim vmesnikom aplikacije.

trans-unit.id: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a TV, ampliifer) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.source: You may create network based custom controls (for example to control a network-enabled device like a TV, ampliifer) in the app that can connect to any hosts you specify on your local network or over the Internet. If you deny these connections, these custom controls will not work.
trans-unit.target: V aplikaciji lahko ustvarite omrežne kontrolnike po meri (na primer za upravljanje omrežne naprave, kot je televizor ali ojačevalnik), ki se lahko povežejo s katerim koli gostiteljem, ki ga določite v lokalnem omrežju ali prek interneta. Če te povezave zavrnete, ti kontrolniki po meri ne bodo delovali.

trans-unit.id:
**%@ License Issue Detected**
This installation has been remotely deactivated, or the hardware identifiers have changed since the last license activation. This may have occurred due to a hardware upgrade or migration to a new device.
Please reactivate this installation to continue using Pro features.
trans-unit.source:
**%@ License Issue Detected**
This installation has been remotely deactivated, or the hardware identifiers have changed since the last license activation. This may have occurred due to a hardware upgrade or migration to a new device.
Please reactivate this installation to continue using Pro features.
trans-unit.target:
**%@ Zaznana je bila težava z licenco**
Ta namestitev je bila deaktivirana na daljavo ali pa so se identifikatorji strojne opreme spremenili od zadnje aktivacije licence. To se je morda zgodilo zaradi nadgradnje strojne opreme ali selitve na novo napravo.
Če želite še naprej uporabljati funkcije Pro, znova aktivirajte to namestitev.
trans-unit.note: 50000 - License activation alert. %@ is the app name; reactivation refers to this installation, not restarting the app.

trans-unit.id:
**%@ Outdated License**
The provided license was originally issued for an earlier version of %@ and has already been extended once with a complimentary upgrade to a subsequent major version.
This license no longer covers the current app version (v%@). To use this version of %@, please purchase a new license.
Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
trans-unit.source:
**%1$@ Outdated License**
The provided license was originally issued for an earlier version of %2$@ and has already been extended once with a complimentary upgrade to a subsequent major version.
This license no longer covers the current app version (v%3$@). To use this version of %4$@, please purchase a new license.
Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
trans-unit.target:
**%1$@ Zastarela licenca**

Are you sure you want the app to reset macOS display settings? The system will reboot after the reset.
Clearing NVRAM also removes low-level firmware preferences, such as startup disk and boot-related settings. macOS will recreate or reset them as appropriate after restart.

Ali ste prepričani, da želite, da aplikacija ponastavi nastavitve zaslonov macOS? Po ponastavitvi se bo sistem znova zagnal.

trans-unit.id: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.source: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.target: Razširjen razpon svetilnosti in 16 bpc za večjo barvno natančnost (privzeto 8 bpc, SDR). Z barvnim profilom, združljivim s HDR (priporočen je `Display P3`), se vsebina HDR ohrani pri zrcaljenju na zaslon HDR/EDR. Celozaslonski tok in okno PIP z omogočenima možnostma `Video filtri` in `Obdelava filtrov HDR` pravilno prikažeta vsebino HDR. Tone lahko preslikate tudi ročno z ustreznim filtrom `Osvetlitev`, da razlikujete ravni svetilnosti HDR do navideznih 10.000 nitov.
trans-unit.note: 53454 - Help for the virtual screen HDR and 16-bit color setting. Backticked Video Filters, HDR Filter Pipeline and Exposure refer to localized UI controls; Display P3 is a color profile name.

trans-unit.id: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.source: The app will apply the loaded EDID when this display is connected. The operation causes the screen to flicker and switch modes if the existing mode is not available with the updated EDID. If the new EDID has different id data (vendor, model, serial), the display will be redetected as a different one. Hold ⇧ Shift on startup to enable safe mode and avoid auto-apply. Physically reconnect display to revert back to the original in case of serious trouble.
trans-unit.target: Aplikacija bo uporabila naložen EDID, ko bo ta zaslon povezan. Operacija povzroči utripanje zaslona in zamenjavo načinov, če obstoječi način ni na voljo s posodobljenim EDID. Če ima novi EDID drugačne ID podatke (prodajalec, model, serija), bo zaslon ponovno zaznan kot drug. Držite ⇧ Shift ob zagonu, da omogočite varni način in se izognete samodejni uporabi. Ponovno fizično povežite zaslon, da se v primeru resnih težav povrnete na izvirnik.
trans-unit.note: 50000 - Automatic EDID application safety and recovery help.

Aplikacija bo pozabila vse shranjene vrednosti DDC in vse kontrole obravnavala kot nedotaknjene. Drsniki se bodo vrnili na privzete nevtralne vrednosti.

trans-unit.id: The device doesn’t support range-based volume control (i.e., setting a specific level on a scale between a minimum and maximum). It does support remote-style volume up/down and mute toggles, which works well for keyboard control. Volume control may not work optimally if an AV receiver is connected and HDMI‑CEC is handling volume between the TV and the receiver.
trans-unit.source: The device doesn’t support range-based volume control (i.e., setting a specific level on a scale between a minimum and maximum). It does support remote-style volume up/down and mute toggles, which works well for keyboard control. Volume control may not work optimally if an AV receiver is connected and HDMI‑CEC is handling volume between the TV and the receiver.
trans-unit.target: Naprava ne podpira nadzora glasnosti na podlagi obsega (tj. nastavitve določene ravni na lestvici med minimalno in maksimalno vrednostjo). Nadzor glasnosti morda ne bo deloval optimalno, če je priključen AV-sprejemnik in HDMI-CEC upravlja glasnost med televizorjem in sprejemnikom.

trans-unit.id: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. Many TVs and TV-derived smart monitors do not support DDC. trans-unit.id: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.source: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.target: Določa, kako se med konfiguracijo in zaznavanjem shranjeni podatki zaslona povežejo z zaznanim zaslonom. Osnovni identifikatorji vključujejo ID proizvajalca, ID modela in serijsko številko. Razširjeni vključujejo še ime izdelka, alfanumerično serijsko številko in datum izdelave. Možnosti z vrati in lokacijo upoštevajo tudi podatke o strojni povezavi.

trans-unit.source:
This should remove the display from the display layout.
On Intel Macs, soft-disconnecting a display does not put it fully to sleep and may not work as expected. While it is disconnected through the app, physically turning it off, unplugging it, or closing the built-in display lid can leave the Mac without a display until restart.

To naj bi odstranilo zaslon iz razporeditve zaslonov.
Na računalnikih Mac s procesorjem Intel programski odklop zaslona ne preklopi povsem v spanje in morda ne deluje po pričakovanjih. Če med programskim odklopom zaslon fizično izklopite, odklopite kabel ali zaprete pokrov vgrajenega zaslona, lahko Mac ostane brez zaslona do ponovnega zagona.

trans-unit.id: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.source: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Ko je omogočeno povečevanje svetlosti HDR in onemogočeno strojno upravljanje svetlosti, aplikacija uporablja neprekinjeno lestvico od nič do umerjene največje vrednosti. Nevtralna nastavitev (100⁠% svetlosti, pri kateri se podrobnosti vsebine HDR ohranijo) zato morda ne sovpada z mejo segmenta OSD in jo je težko doseči z bližnjicami. Za rešitev se pri 100⁠% svetlosti vstavi dodaten korak znotraj segmenta.
trans-unit.note: 50000 - Neutral software HDR brightness keyboard step setting help.

trans-unit.target: ⚠️ Če želite zrcaliti/pretakati navidezni zaslon na izvirno povezan zaslon samo za pridobitev prilagodljivih ločljivosti HiDPI, je priporočljivo, da namesto tega uporabite funkcijo prilagodljivega skaliranja, če je to mogoče! Če želite uporabiti zrcaljenje namesto pretakanja, lahko to omogočite v meniju aplikacije, ko je navidezni zaslon povezan.
trans-unit.note: 50000 - Virtual screen help recommending flexible scaling for native displays when only flexible HiDPI resolutions are needed.
